protein:ObaG|Q96PL5.function_text: Possible role as a cell-adhesion or receptor molecule of erythroid cells

protein:KtzT|Q04446.function_text: Glycogen-branching enzyme participates in the glycogen biosynthetic process along with glycogenin and glycogen synthase. Generates alpha-1,6-glucosidic branches from alpha-1,4-linked glucose chains, to increase solubility of the glycogen polymer (PubMed:26199317, PubMed:8463281, PubMed:8613547)
catalytic_activity: Transfers a segment of a (1->4)-alpha-D-glucan chain to a primary hydroxy group in a similar glucan chain.
L-lysine + NADPH + O2 = N(6)-hydroxy-L-lysine + NADP(+) + H2O

protein:PntM|E3VWI3.function_text: Catalyzes the final step in the biosynthesis of the sesquiterpenoid antibiotic pentalenolactone by mediating the oxidative rearrangement of pentalenolactone F to pentalenolactone
catalytic_activity: pentalenolactone F + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + O2 + 2 H(+) = pentalenolactone + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 H2O

protein:NosL|O68481.function_text: May act as a metallochaperone involved in nitrous oxide reductase assembly. Specifically binds Cu(+)
